milestones.title: 1.0 — First release
milestones.description: Initial production release supporting 44 Ubuntu 26.04 flavors across seven tiers: Base, Containers (Docker and Podman), Kubernetes, K3s Edge, CloudNative, AI Inference and Homelab appliances.

milestones.title: v1.1.0 - Multi-Hypervisor & Bare-Metal Hardening
milestones.description: Direct disk streaming installer, native Unraid virtiofs auto-mount, VMware ESXi 8.x validation, and iPXE netboot.

milestones.title: v1.2.0 - Blackwell Fabric & Multi-Vendor Inference
milestones.description: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 / RTX 5090 NVLink fabric tuning, AMD Instinct MI300 ROCm 10 optimization, and automated vLLM benchmarks. Note of 2026-10-11: this milestone was closed empty. No issue was ever filed under it, and the scope above was not delivered as tracked work. The scope is reviewed together with the hardware acceleration roadmap after the 1.0 release.

milestones.title: v1.3.0 - Aegis & Nucleus Fleet Contracts
milestones.description: Pinned producer contracts with the connected Aegis-OS stack: the aegis.p01.product-input.v1 build request and the imago.nucleus.kernel-artifact.v1 kernel artifact manifest, verified by digest and provenance before consumption. Tracks planning milestones ms-aegis and ms-nucleus.

milestones.title: Post-1.0 roadmap
milestones.description: Planned items that accepted ADRs, the principles or an earlier plan promise and that have no implementation yet. Each issue records the promise and the state of the tree. An issue here is a tracked home for the plan, not a scheduled unit: order and scope are decided after the 1.0 release.
